own_experiment.question: How much of the teacher's starting weights must a noise-trained student share for the hidden skill to transfer?
own_experiment.hypothesis: I expected a smooth, roughly proportional fade: sharing 50% of the initial weights would give about half the accuracy gain of a full copy, and 0% would stay near the untrained level.

conditions.label: 0% of initial weights shared with the teacher
50% of initial weights shared with the teacher
90% of initial weights shared with the teacher
100% of initial weights shared with the teacher

own_experiment.conclusion: Mean student accuracy: 0% shared 0.112, 50% 0.094, 90% 0.698, 100% 0.921 (untrained 0.081). A proportional fade would put 50% near 0.516; instead it sat at chance level, so my hypothesis was wrong: the hidden channel needs the starting weights to be almost identical, and breaks well before they are completely different.
